Ride Riverside Slow Roll

Riverside, IL · Social

Beginner friendly

Ride Riverside Slow Roll is a social group ride in Riverside, IL. It rolls second Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from Guthrie Park, across from the Riverside train station. Pace: slow.

Next ride Fri, Oct 9, 6:00 PM CDT

For visitors

The group calls itself a community bicycle group. Its page gives the date for each month of the season.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow.
Check
Look at @rideriversideil the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ride Riverside Slow Roll group ride

Riverside's monthly slow roll, from the park by the train station. The 2026 season runs April to October, and Oct 9 is the last ride of the year.
